title: WhoHitMe
description: Shows who attacked you in Minecraft.
body:
WhoHitMe is a lightweight mod that helps players identify the source of incoming damage. Whether you're attacked by a mob, shot by a skeleton, or hit by another player, this mod displays a clear HUD message showing who hurt you.


Features
- Displays attacker name and damage type on screen
- Works with armor
- Fully configurable via whohitme-client.toml
- Supports multiple HUD styles and positions
- Localized in English and Ukrainian

Gameplay Impact
- Helps players react faster during combat
- Improves awareness in chaotic fights
- Useful for PvP, mob ambushes, and hardcore survival
